title: aperiodic-classifying-invariant
description: The degree-1 cohomology class cl-inv(v) := [1_{F_U}] in H^1(T*_{<=kappa}, F_U) extracted from an aperiodic settling; the complete invariant classifying aperiodic-regime knowledge presheaves up to mutually-locally-derivable equivalence.

settling.description: the aperiodic settling v over (L, C, E, lambda), with closure ordinal kappa and increment sequence U, from which the class is computed

degree.description: the invariant is a class in H^1; settling cohomology vanishes above degree 1, and H^1 carries the obstructions distinguishing inequivalent aperiodic orbits

class.description: the identity class [1_{F_U}] of the settling-associated sheaf F_U, the cohomology class of the identity cochain summing newly-designated generators at each stage

nonzeroOnAperiodic.description: for aperiodic regime the cohomology does not stabilize at any countable ordinal, so cl-inv can be non-zero (whereas it is forced to zero for strict and Scott-continuous regimes)

completeForMLD.description: v ~_MLD v' iff cl-inv(v) = cl-inv(v'): the class is the complete invariant for aperiodic settlings up to mutually-locally-derivable equivalence
